title: maackia amurensis var. typica
intro: Maackia amurensis var. typica, commonly known as Siberian golden pilsartree or Amur maackia, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Maackia amurensis var. typica include reducing fever, alleviating cough, and treating gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
